scope: Synthetic qualification cases with real OpenRouter inference, production Arena broker validation, worker socket, disposable PostgreSQL ArenaStore, raw object readback, readable export and strict unscored training-step reconstruction. Not a scored ICP, live miner or production-round quality evaluation.
privacy: ZDR; data_collection deny; exact provider pin; no fallback; existing redaction unchanged.
reasoning_semantics: Full provider-exposed unsummarized generated text. Does not expose private withheld computation or prove causal faithfulness. Explicit zero-token turns are valid, not missing reasoning.
limitations: Only text inputs and two synthetic tool continuations tested; vision and hosted search are not newly certified.
Two scenarios are compatibility evidence, not a statistical reliability guarantee or lead-quality score.
json_object asks the provider for JSON syntax; exact shape is verified locally. text means prompted JSON with no native response-format guarantee.
Requested provider suffixes are pinned; returned endpoint metadata independently confirms provider and model version, not quantization suffix.
Synthetic exports retain unverified task/scoring gaps. No invented production score or complete-trajectory eligibility.
